Siddharth Iyer | siddharth.iyer887@example.com | +91 9652023280
Koramangala, Bengaluru, India
Analytical finance professional with hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting. Notice period: 60 days.

Financial Analyst, GreenGrid — Sep 2024 - Apr 2026
Led monthly forecasting cycles and produced rolling forecasts for revenue and operating expenses, improving forecast accuracy by 12% through enhanced driver-based Financial Modeling. Built scenario models in Microsoft Excel to assess tariff changes, resulting in a recommended pricing adjustment that increased margin per MWh by 3 percentage points. Performed detailed Variance Analysis on monthly P&L and operational KPIs, identifying cost overruns and enabling a corrective plan that cut variable costs by 6%. Supported FP&A presentations to senior leadership and collaborated with operations to align capacity assumptions.

FP&A Manager, Bluefin Logistics — Mar 2022 - Aug 2024
Owned quarterly budgeting and annual planning processes, consolidating inputs across 15 business units and implementing standardized templates in Microsoft Excel that reduced close time by 20%. Designed IFRS-compliant reporting pack and led monthly FP&A reviews with business heads. Conducted Variance Analysis to explain deviations in freight and fuel costs versus plan, driving initiatives that lowered route cost per ton-km by 4%. Mentored junior analysts on Financial Modeling best practices and introduced Jira to track finance requests and cross-functional tasks.

Financial Analyst, Covalent Infotech — Jun 2020 - Feb 2022
Built end-to-end Financial Modeling for project-level profitability and pricing analyses, enabling more accurate bid decisions that improved win-margin estimates. Performed monthly Variance Analysis between actuals and budgets, isolating labor and subcontract variances and recommending corrective actions that recovered 2% margin. Prepared management reports and dashboards in Microsoft Excel to track utilization and billable hours, supporting leadership in capacity planning and client pricing discussions.

Skills: Financial Modeling, FP&A, Microsoft Excel, IFRS, Variance Analysis, Jira

Education: CA, ICAI
